slug: 从效法万妖开始成就真仙
lines: “都说有仙，但谁也没见过。”
老杨曾经是习武之人，见识比不得城中的豪绅大户，但肯定要比普通老百姓强些。
他咂咂嘴，神情艳羡：“但有些人祖坟冒青烟，偶然接触到跟仙人有关系的宝贝，哪怕只领悟出一招半式，就能摇身一变，成为修士大人。”
说到这里，瘸子突然怔神。
他偷偷看了眼林舒。
对方最近的表现，简直像极了自己刚才说的那种人。
“这种宝贝很多吗？”林舒来了兴趣。
“不多，但寻常老百姓运气好也能碰到。”
老杨曾经就见过南郊的穷小子，靠着家里的一只破碗，成功在西城安了家。
他叹口气：“只是要专门去找的话，那可就不是靠钱能解决的事情了。”
“而且大部分人就算悟出了仙法，待到身上的仙缘用尽了，这辈子也别想再使出来一次。”
林舒若有所思的点点头。
瘸子口中的仙缘，大概率就是自己身上的雾气，姓言的女人称它们为灵力。
听起来不对劲啊。
这哪里像是正宗的修行路子。
合着大部分人都是撞运气的野狐禅。
“那些悟出仙法的人，难道没有将其传下来？”林舒皱了皱眉，察觉到问题所在。
“哪有那么容易，顿悟会消耗掉仙家宝贝上的灵光，使它变成普通物件，如果没有亲身感受过仙人的气息，又怎么可能学会他的仙法。”
老杨讪讪一笑。
林舒提出来的这些问题，估计每个黑水城长大的老百姓都琢磨过。
毕竟谁不想当个高高在上的修士。
所以他先前才说这是众所周知的事情。
林舒沉思片刻，缓缓蹙眉。
事情好像比想象的要复杂许多。
如此珍稀的宝物，就算有存留，也不是一头狐狸能够获得的。
至于碰运气……
林舒从床上起身，在窗边站定。
他俯瞰着这条阴暗巷子。
看来得更快打出点名堂了，唯有站得更高，才有接触到那些东西的机会。
老杨盯着青年的背影，有些发懵。
对方完全不担心鸿运武馆的报复，看上去反而更在意这些虚无缥缈的传闻。
“行了，你帮我看着点这里，有事情就派人来叫我。”
林舒活动了下身躯，转身朝门外而去。
已经夜深，巷子空荡。
窑姐们也准备收拾休息，应该不会再出什么问题。
对于这窑子里的氛围，林舒是真的不太喜欢，更别提住进来。
“去，去哪儿叫你？”老杨抠了抠后脑勺。

"They all say there are immortals, but no one has ever seen one."
Lao Yang was once a martial arts practitioner, and his knowledge was not as good as that of the wealthy gentry in the city, but he was definitely better than ordinary people.
He smacked his lips and looked envious: "But some people come into contact with treasures related to immortals by chance, even if they only understand one and a half moves, they can transform into monks."
At this point, the lame man suddenly became stunned.
He glanced at Lin Shu secretly.
The other party's recent behavior is exactly like the kind of person I just mentioned.
"Are there many such treasures?" Lin Shu became interested.
"Not many, but ordinary people can encounter them if they are lucky."
Lao Yang once saw a poor boy from the southern suburbs successfully settling in Xicheng with a broken bowl at home.
He sighed: "If you just have to look for it specifically, it's not something that can be solved with money."
"And even if most people realize the immortal magic, when their immortality is used up, they will never be able to use it again in this life."
"..."
Lin Shu nodded thoughtfully.
The fairy fate mentioned by the lame man is most likely the mist on his body. The woman named Yan calls them spiritual power.
Something doesn't sound right.
This doesn't look like an authentic way of cultivation.
Co-authored by Yehu Zen, most people just hit their luck.
"Didn't those who realized the immortal magic pass it down?" Lin Shu frowned, realizing the problem.
"It's not that easy. Enlightenment will consume the spiritual light on the fairy's treasure and turn it into an ordinary object. If you haven't personally experienced the breath of the fairy, how can you learn his magic."
Old Yang smiled.
It is estimated that every citizen who grew up in Heishui City has pondered these questions raised by Lin Shu.
After all, who doesn’t want to be a high-ranking monk?
That's why he said before that this was something everyone knows.
"Hiss."
Lin Shu thought for a moment and frowned slowly.
Things seem to be more complicated than imagined.
Such a rare treasure, even if it survives, cannot be obtained by a fox.
As for trying your luck...
Lin Shu got up from the bed and stood by the window.
He looked down the dark alley.
It seems that we have to make a name for ourselves faster. Only by standing higher can we have the opportunity to come into contact with those things.
"Uh."
Lao Yang stared at the young man's back, a little confused.
The other party is not worried about the Hongyun Martial Arts School's revenge at all, but seems to be more concerned about these mythical rumors.
"Okay, please keep an eye on this place for me. If anything happens, send someone to call me."
Lin Shu moved his body, turned around and walked out the door.
It was late at night and the alley was empty.
The kiln sisters are also preparing to clean up and rest, so there should be no more problems.
Lin Shu really didn't like the atmosphere in this kiln, let alone live in it.
"Go, where can I call you?" Old Yang scratched the back of his head.
